description: Nerazvrstane ceste na području Grada Novigrada-Cittanova is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Novigrad – Cittanova. Under Articles 8 and 9. Decisions on unclassified roads in the area of the City of Novigrad-Cittanova, Administrative Department for Municipal System, Physical Planning and Environmental Protection of the City of Novigrad-Cittanova maintains a unique database on unclassified roads. Coverage: Grad Novigrad – Cittanova. The portal shows the English title as "Unclassified roads in the area of the City of Novigrad-Cittanova" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Novigrad – Cittanova. Its keywords include ceste, nerazvrstane ceste, lokalna samouprava. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
